gist: French drug gangs recruit children from across France for dealing, torture and murder.
Gangs like DZ Mafia use social media to entice vulnerable young people to Marseille.
Authorities warn the expanding drug trade threatens France's criminal justice system.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: French drug gangs, such as DZ Mafia, are recruiting children across the country via social media to carry out trafficking, torture and murder in Marseille. Vulnerable teenagers lured by money end up trapped in violence and criminal exploitation.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: France's expanding illegal drug trade generates €7bn annually, with over 10,000 children involved during 2025. Officials warn that gang operations and violence threaten national security and risk causing a systemic breakdown of the criminal justice system.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The number of cocaine users in France is expected to reach two million soon. Meanwhile, law enforcement agencies face a growing challenge as gangs continue using online platforms to replace arrested members.
